header: Vacancies as rows, one target each
lead: Job title, location and contract type, and a link to the posting. The whole row is the link rather than the four words of the title, so a reader on a phone does not have to aim.
note: The note holds the speculative-application line that follows the list — the sentence for the reader none of the rows fitted.

roles.title: The title is the row's label
roles.description: and the description carries the location and the contract type

roles.title: Dividers, not gaps
roles.description: a rule between rows reads as one list rather than as separate cards

roles.title: A row without a link stays
roles.description: rendered as plain text, because a dead link is worse than none
